source: Previously cached official Maven container image; extracted /opt/java/openjdk into WSL Linux filesystem without starting the container
execution: Native WSL Ubuntu JVM and Python; no container or Windows java.exe in measured path
setupNotes: Ubuntu originally had no native JDK. An initial OpenJDK 25 apt install completed before the experiment was changed to JDK 21.
Ubuntu apt JDK 21 download failed on the WSL network path. A partial Windows download was stopped and retained with .partial suffix under ignored .lab-artifacts/linux-runtime.
The experiment uses explicit Temurin 21 paths for both java and jcmd. The WSL system java command may still resolve to OpenJDK 25.
